subject.title: [Bug]: Enabling Codex plugin causes Runtime to switch to OpenAI Codex and ignore configured primary model, resulting in GPT-5.4-nano TPM failures

question: Should maintainers treat this as expected session-pin recovery behavior, or as a fresh-session Codex hot-reload runtime selection regression?
rationale: Source inspection supports the session-pin explanation, but the reporter also claims a clean reproduction, and a code change before live proof could hit the wrong owner boundary.

options.title: Run fresh-session repro
options.body: Verify DeepSeek primary with no session pin before changing runtime selection code.

options.title: Treat as session pin recovery
options.body: If only a prior /model openai/... selection reproduces it, improve status/doctor guidance and close with evidence.

options.title: Fix hot-reload selection
options.body: If enabling Codex alone rewrites selection, repair gateway session/runtime resolution and add focused regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Run fresh-session repro
recommendation.body: Verify DeepSeek primary with no session pin before changing runtime selection code.

likelyOwner.reason: The likely decision spans the Codex harness and selected-session model resolver history he introduced or recently shaped.
